description_en: Queries the traffic sequences and their details for the current site
description_zh: 查询当前站点的流量序列以及序列的详细信息
name: GetSiteTrafficSequence

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain the site ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site. After version management is enabled for the site, you can specify a site version number to obtain the traffic sequence information of the corresponding version. The default version is 0. If version management is not enabled for the site, you do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 站点的版本号。站点开通版本管理后，可以通过传入指定站点版本号，以获取对应版本的流量序列信息。默认查询版本0；站点未开启版本管理时，则不需要传该参数
parameters.name: site_version
